text:
maria: Quick sync — I'm drafting the PRD for the rollout experiment around model-version pinning + A/B safety checks. Customer-driven ask from Acme: ability to pin a fallback model for select customers during rollouts. Need acceptance criteria, rollback rules, and experiment design by EOD Thu. PRD skeleton: https://redwood.link/prd-pin-experiment

alex: Clarifying — is this only for hosted customers or should Private/Dedicated be included?

maria: Start with hosted (highest impact). Call out Dedicated/Private as follow-up; those need config toggles + ops runbook.

simon: Metric list proposal (quick):
- p50/p95 latency (tokens/ms)
- token cost delta (usd/token)
- quality delta on eval set (BLEU/ROUGE or custom eval)
- production error rate (5xx/timeout)
- customer-facing regressions (manual)

ea: We'll need a ground-truth eval set from Acme + a small golden set for internal QA. Also track inference cache-hit rate (prefix caching) — pinning can change cache behavior.

eva: Rollout ramp idea: 0 -> 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h windows, with hold at each stage for at least 6h and 2000 requests. Pin-window for pinned customers = 30 days by default, configurable per-customer.

alex: Quick config stub I can add to PRD:```yaml
experiment:
  name: pinning-safety-v1
  groups: [control, variant]
  variant_model: rdx-model-v2
  pin_window_days: 30
  rollout_ramp: [5,25,50,100]
  hold_min_hours: 6
  hold_min_requests: 2000
  auto_rollback_on: [quality_drop_pct, error_rate_pct]
```

simon: Edge cases: traffic skew (small orgs with low traffic), cached KV behavior across variants, multi-tenant pin mixing, and telemetry lag. Acceptance criteria must include minimum sample sizes per stage.

eva: Rollback triggers (proposal): auto-rollback if ANY of:
- quality_delta <= -3% on customer eval set (stat sig)
- increase in production error rate by >= 0.5% absolute OR 100% relative if baseline tiny
- p95 latency increase > 200ms AND user-visible errors > 0.1%
Manual rollback: PM or SRE can trigger if customer escalates.

maria: Good. Please add definitions for "quality_delta" (how we compute, window, stat test) and a simple runbook for ops. Owners: @alex experiments, @simon metrics & stats, @eva ops/runbook. I'll own the PRD write-up + sign-off.

devops-bot: scheduled canary job created: job_id=canary-20240508-77, will start at 2024-05-09T02:00Z :gear:

alex: I'll add the smoke tests + a quick harness to simulate pinning traffic and validate cache behavior. Will post PR with config + test results by Wed.

simon: I'll draft the stats plan (A/B test buckets, sample size calc, significance thresholds, one-sided vs two-sided) and attach to PRD.

maria: Thanks. My ask: keep replies inline in the PRD draft so we have a single source. If anything looks risky for Dedicated/Private, flag it separately.

eva: noted. I'll write the rollback playbook and include operator commands + metrics to watch.

maria: solid — next checkpoint Thurs 9am PT in sync. :thumbsup:
